text:
sqlpipe moves rows from Postgres to S3. It has three processes: a reader, a converter, and an uploader. The processes run as a pipeline.

The reader connects to Postgres. It streams rows from the database in batches. Each batch has a fixed maximum row count. The reader sends each batch to the converter.

The converter receives batches from the reader. It converts each batch into a Parquet row group. It appends each row group to an output buffer. When the buffer reaches the target size, the converter sends the buffer to the uploader.

The uploader writes each buffer to S3 as one part of a multipart upload. If a part upload fails, the uploader sends that part again. After all parts upload, the uploader completes the multipart object.
